hypotheses.B1_weight_rank32_compresses_native_bank: The top 32 left singular vectors of the frozen native bank's Down columns recover at least 0.75 downstream fidelity to the exact native patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.B2_activation_rank32_nearly_recovers_nat: A rank-32 output basis learned from leave-one-pair-out discovery uses recovers at least 0.90 downstream fidelity to the exact native patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.B3_activation_rank16_beats_weight_rank16: The activation-weighted rank-16 basis exceeds the weight-SVD rank-16 basis by at least 0.05 native-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.B4_activation_rank32_preserves_full_mlp_: Activation rank 32 is within 0.05 full-MLP fidelity of the exact native patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.B5_weight_top32_is_specific: Weight top-32 exceeds weight bottom-32 by at least 0.30 native-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.B6_activation_code_transfers_ood: TinyStories activation-rank-32 native-patch fidelity retains at least 85 percent of FineWeb fidelity.
